correctness.rationale: The reduced Hopf trace on oriented augmented simplicial chains gives −I(Q_g;−1): a fixed independent set with s orbits and t vertices contributes (−1)^(t−1)(−1)^(t−s)=(−1)^(s−1), and the empty face contributes −1. The a-quotient is P_{ceil(n/2)}□P_6 for odd n and P_{n/2−1}□P_6 for even n after deleting center-edge orbits; the b quotient is a 2-row ladder. For the half-turn, the even and odd center conflicts yield explicit integral boundary vectors e and o. I independently constructed all 21 admissible column masks and the integer transfer matrix, and exactly computed T^28 on all three boundary vectors, obtaining equality component by component. The first-period F28 and Z56 tables and n=1, n=57, F0/F28 boundary values match; excluding proper divisors establishes LEAST period 56. An independent orbit-conflict graph and deletion recurrence gave exact agreement for all four group elements and n=1..10 (40 cases); 4000 virtual character multiplicity-integrality checks and n=8 degree-11 representation were also consistent. Infinite all-n conclusion comes from orbit derivation and finite exact matrix identities, NOT extrapolation of finite widths.

value.rationale: Geometric horizontal/vertical involutions form a canonical V4 symmetry of every open six-row grid, and their alternating rational homology representation is a natural invariant not recoverable from Betti numbers or an ordinary Euler characteristic. A complete all-n exact formula supplies the full virtual reflection character; the half-turn has a least period twice the known ordinary period (56 versus 28) and uniformly bounded nonconstant values ±1,±3,±5. At n=8 it yields an actual five-dimensional rational H11 decomposition into multiplicities (2,1,0,2), information that the known wedge-of-five-spheres result cannot identify. The classification can support subsequent equivariant-topology and symmetry-restricted counting inquiries; it is not a textbook restatement of an ordinary transfer table.
residual_risks: Scope limited to six-row open grids, alternating character, and rational coefficients; no arbitrary-width equivariant homotopy classification is claimed.

limitations: Restricted to rational reduced alternating homology characters of P_n□P_6 for n>=1 and standard open grid boundary.
